title: How to read a tarot spread, step by step
description: A four-step method for reading any tarot spread: set the question, check the positions, read each card, then read the whole tarot spread together.

scenes.headline: How to read a tarot spread, step by step
scenes.caption: Read a tarot spread in a set order, one step at a time, and even a large layout stays manageable.
scenes.vo: Read a tarot spread in a set order, one step at a time, and even a large layout stays manageable.

scenes.headline: Step 1: start with the question
scenes.caption: Before you turn a card, decide what you want to think about.
scenes.vo: Step one: start with the question. Before you turn a card, decide what you want to think about.

scenes.headline: Step 2: check the positions
scenes.caption: Look at the layout before you look at the pictures. Each position has a job. In a three-card spread, the positions might be past, present and next.
scenes.vo: Step two: check the positions. Look at the layout before you look at the pictures. Each position has a job. In a three-card spread, the positions might be past, present and next.

scenes.headline: Have a tarot spread in front of you?
scenes.caption: Photograph it and get a clear reading, card by card.
scenes.vo: Have a tarot spread in front of you? Photograph it at read my spread dot com, and get a clear reading, card by card.
